bundle.limits: Sample parse timings only; peak memory/concurrency/cloud CPU/billing acceptance NOT_RUN

source.deploymentInput: NOT_PREPARED: clean exact-file snapshot + transitive dependency/lockfile manifest + separate build SHA required; never deploy dirty worktree

host.namespaceAvailability: UNVERIFIED_NOT_RESERVED; prior DNS NXDOMAIN is not availability proof

identities.A: S2-TEST-A: synthetic preparer and eligible Profile mechanism fixture only
identities.C: S2-TEST-C: independent synthetic source reviewer, no artifact-read grant
identities.subject: S2-FICTIONAL-SME
identities.profileVsBusiness: Profile fixture mechanism success never admits Business download

names: Private artifact metadata/grant secrets under admitted existing Owner contract
secrets.requirement: Fresh test-only keys and isolated authentication; no production secrets/session issuer/credential files

writeAllowlist: Synthetic test metadata and exact Profile artifact fixture
Minimal test audit and campaign-scoped cleanup in approved D1/R2 only

productionDenylist.actualNewBindingVerification: Required after separately approved creation and before test execution

safeguards.runtime: BLOCKED: local harness allows localhost only; cloud exact-host/mode/resource allowlist and fail-closed kill switches not implemented/admitted
safeguards.identity: BLOCKED: x-test-account and x-probe-user are local synthetic harness headers, not cloud authentication; must be removed or confined behind separately approved isolated runner; no public fault injection
safeguards.bindings: BLOCKED: actual independent D1/R2 IDs + least-privilege credentials + denial proof absent
safeguards.network: REQUIRED: no provider/payment bindings and default-deny outbound network; not cloud verified
safeguards.killSwitch: REQUIRED: server ingress off + writes off by default; named operator; not cloud verified

retention.trigger: Campaign start; earlier cleanup at completion or abort
retention.scope: Synthetic uploads, full PDFs, D1 metadata, test grant/session data, orphan objects and any copies/backups
retention.evidence: Keep only redacted hashes/counts/status receipts; retention and location require Owner decision
retention.cleanup: Named operator reconciles D1/R2 inventory, retries failed deletes, records outstanding objects; do not claim complete while failures remain
retention.legalPolicy: No real-customer retention or legal-hold policy admitted

stopRules: Do not start if campaign cannot remain within verified free allocation
Stop ingress/writes on nonzero incremental cost, unknown usage, exhausted allowance or reconciliation failure
cost.hardCap: No verified automatic platform cost cap; usage stop may lag. B/C remain blocked without accepted enforceable control

recovery.scope: Prepared/object-written/indexed/complete/failure boundaries under existing owner; verify by readback

rollback: Disable staging ingress, stop writes, restore reviewed test build; reconcile test indexes/objects and record cleanup failures

ownerActions.A: Name operators; accept exact host/mode/accounts A/B/C/fixture/limits/24h cleanup/cost and remaining safeguards
ownerActions.B: Separate explicit resource/config-write scope, executor, account and cost approval after configuration blockers resolved
ownerActions.C: Separate approval of exact deployed SHA, actual IDs, isolation evidence and campaign window; not implied by A/B

firstBlocker: A_CONFIGURATION_INCOMPLETE: named operators/custodian and exact isolated cloud authorization+host/mode/binding/kill-switch contract absent; local harness is not deployable
plan: Verify exact Host, Mode, actual bindings and authenticated A/B/C
Prove production IDs and domains inaccessible; stop safely without credentials
Upload frozen synthetic CSV/controlled PDF/literal XLSX within limits
Read private R2 object and D1 metadata/version/SHA
Run existing Financial formulas; keep Loans composition Unknown
Generate using existing template mechanism and retrieve full Profile-fixture PDF; compare exact bytes/SHA
Deny B access, wrong Subject and revoked/expired grants
Inject authorized isolated failures, recover/reopen; distinguish D1 and R2 phases
Reconcile inventory, clean up, verify cost and retain redacted repeat-readable evidence
